dedupe_keys.name: two dimensional hec ras dam break model of three cascade reservoirs under full and partial collapse scenarios

description: This paper builds a two-dimensional hydrodynamic dam-break model in HEC-RAS for three cascade reservoirs, called RE1, RE2 and RE3, in the lower Southwest China river basin, to study how sequential dam breaches propagate. Terrain comes from ASTER GDEM at about 12.5 metres, the reservoirs are represented as linear reservoirs, the control basin is a 20 metre grid of about 1.26 million cells, and overtopping is assumed to cause failure. Four scenarios are simulated: all three partial collapse, two full and one partial, all three full collapse, and no breach with overtopping only. Simultaneous full collapse gives peak flows of 341,200, 1,157,900 and 340,100 cubic metres per second and maximum depths at four sites of 48 to 80 metres. Coverage: one basin, four scenarios. Access: a free article; the article is CC BY 4.0, and the model files are not offered. Caveats: no validation against an observed event was seen, and assumptions such as instantaneous collapse give worst-case envelopes. It supports cascading dam failure and emergency planning studies, and relates to the Brumadinho HEC-RAS and Derna dam breach case studies in the catalogue.
